labels.what: for GENIE CV and NuWro: the in-phase-space cross section's share at p_parallel 4.5-60 GeV/c (pz_4.5_60.share_of_in_ps), and the share from E_nu > 20 GeV within p_parallel 1.5-4.5 and within 4.5-60 (share_E_gt_20, each of its own range), the part GiBUU 2019's sample, which stops at E_nu = 20 GeV (KNOWN_ISSUES 82), cannot hold
labels.not: not a GiBUU number: each share is the named generator's, from its own sample over its generation_range_gev
labels.range: both samples stop at E_nu = 50 GeV (generation_range_gev; NuWro's starts at 0.5 GeV), so E_nu > 20 GeV here is 20-50 GeV and every share is of the cross section below 50 GeV; the part above 50 GeV, which neither sample holds, would add to an E_nu > 20 GeV share's numerator and denominator alike, so each share_E_gt_20 is a lower bound on the full-flux share (H2-DEFINITION-ADDENDUM-GIBUU-DOMAIN.md section 1: "two generators that cover E_ν to 50 GeV")
labels.for: state/measurement-paper/5d-community-20261024/FD-DIRECTOR-RULINGS.md section 5 (GiBUU on the eight p_parallel < 4.5 cells)
labels.formula: share_of_in_ps(4.5-60) = sum_b share_of_in_ps[b]; share_E_gt_20(4.5-60) = sum_b share_of_in_ps[b] * share_E_gt_20[b] / share_of_in_ps(4.5-60), over the by_pz bands b with pz[0] >= 4.5
